# WHO

WHO (World Health Organization) is mentioned once in the corpus, in the context of a document about ADHD treatment indicators in Denmark. According to the source, WHO's classification system, ICD-10, defines ADHD as "en neuropsykiatrisk lidelse" (a neuropsychiatric disorder) [^src1]. This classification underpins the document's broader discussion of ADHD as a diagnostic and clinical category, which is used to frame the results of Indicator 11 in the Danish ADHD database — a measure of how quickly adult patients begin ADHD medication treatment after entering a care pathway [^src1].

No relationships, claims, or timeline events involving WHO are present in the corpus. The single mention establishes WHO's significance narrowly: its diagnostic classification (ICD-10) provides the authoritative definition of ADHD used elsewhere in the source document, which otherwise focuses on Danish regional treatment data, such as Region Nordjylland's 85% and Region Hovedstaden's 37% rates of medication initiation within 120 days [^src1].
